note: Hagstofa news release of 22 Jul 2016 on the July 2016 CPI: "Síðastliðna tólf mánuði hefur vísitala neysluverðs hækkað um 1,1%". The covariate is that 12-month change.

Hagtíðindi "Landsframleiðslan 2016" of 9 Mar 2017, the first annual estimate (GDP +7,2%), gives the per-capita figure: "Landsframleiðsla á mann jókst um 5,5% að raungildi árið 2016". THJ01000 was updated the same day (Wayback capture of 22 Mar 2017: "Síðast uppfært 20170309", 1945-2016). First-release value 5.5; the 23 Oct 2026 vintage gives 4.7.
Hagstofa news release of 24 Jul 2020 on the July 2020 CPI: "Síðastliðna tólf mánuði hefur vísitala neysluverðs hækkað um 3,0%". The covariate is that 12-month change.

Hagstofa news release of 26 Feb 2021, the first annual estimate for 2020 (GDP -6,6%), gives the per-capita figure: "Landsframleiðsla á mann dróst saman um 8,2% að raungildi". A Wayback capture of THJ01000 on 6 Mar 2021 holds 2020 (GDP -6,6). First-release value -8.2; the 23 Oct 2026 vintage gives -7.8.
Hagstofa news release of 21 Jul 2023 on the July 2023 CPI: "Síðastliðna tólf mánuði hefur vísitala neysluverðs hækkað um 7,6%". The covariate is that 12-month change.

The news release of 29 Feb 2024, the first annual estimate for 2023 ("Hagvöxtur 4,1% árið 2023"), quotes no per-capita figure. THJ01000, the table the covariate is read from, was updated the same day with 2023 and its "GDP per capita, volume change on previous year" series (Wayback capture of 3 Mar 2024: "Latest update 2/29/2024", reference time 1945-2023). first_release is that table update, the same day as the GDP release. The 23 Oct 2026 vintage gives 2.6.
